get.description: Provides the OpenAPI specification of the Adamik API

200.description: 200 OK - Returns the OpenAPI spec of the Adamik API, in JSON format

post.summary: Get an address from a public key
post.description: Encodes the provided public key to an address for the given chain ID

200.description: 200 OK - Returns true if the encoding is successful, otherwise false.

post.description: Validates the specified address for the given chain ID, returning true if the address is valid, otherwise false.

200.description: 200 OK - Returns true if the address is valid for the specified chain ID, otherwise false.

post.description: Returns the state of a specified account identifier (address or xpub) and chain ID, primarily focusing on available balances. Essential for wallet applications to display up-to-date balance information.

accountId.description: Account identifier (address, xpub, etc) for the specified chain ID

200.description: 200 OK - Returns the current balance information for the specified address and chain ID.

get.summary: Retrieve details for all supported chains
get.description: Retrieves a list of all supported blockchain networks with their detailed information.

200.description: 200 OK - Returns a list of names and detailed information for all supported blockchain networks.

get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific blockchain network identified by chain ID.

200.description: 200 OK - Successfully returns detailed data about the specified blockchain, including its identifier, name, family classification, supported units of currency, and additional configuration parameters.

get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific token for a blockchain network, identified by chain ID and token ID.

parameters.name: tokenId
parameters.description: Token ID. Format depends on the chain, e.g. contract address for EVM chains.

schema.description: Token ID. Format depends on the chain, e.g. contract address for EVM chains.

200.description: 200 OK - Successfully returns detailed data about the token on the specified blockchain.

get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific transaction for a blockchain network, identified by chain ID and transaction ID.

parameters.name: transactionId
parameters.description: Transaction ID. Usually a hash but can be different depending on the chain.

schema.description: Transaction ID. Usually a hash but can be different depending on the chain.

anyOf.description: Include parsed fields in the standard Adamik format. Note that all transactions types may not be available for this option.
Include the raw transaction as provided in native format by the blockchain.

200.description: 200 OK - Successfully returns detailed data about the transaction on the specified blockchain.

post.summary: Retrieve the list of existing validators
post.description: Lists validators for a specified chain ID, including their operational status and commission rates. Supports pagination through 'limit' and 'offset' parameters. Useful for delegation operations on proof-of-stake blockchains.

200.description: 200 OK - Returns a list of validators, their status, and commission details for the specified chain ID.

post.description: Broadcasts a signed transaction to the blockchain, crucial for submitting transactions like transfers, delegations, or reward claims. Returns a transaction receipt (hash) or error details.

200.description: 200 OK - Returns a transaction receipt or error details if the transaction fails.

post.summary: Complete, validate and encode a transaction to sign
post.description: Encodes transaction data into a format suitable for broadcasting. This function is pivotal for creating transactions that comply with the specific requirements of different blockchains.        It also completes the input transaction with computed data, such as fees and max spendable amount, and performs some chain-specific validation checks on the transaction.

200.description: 200 OK - Returns the transaction data encoded into a blockchain-specific format, ready for broadcasting.

post.description: Validates a transaction's format and checks it against the blockchain's current state for potential errors or warnings. This pre-validation is critical for ensuring transaction success rates and for debugging transaction issues.

200.description: 200 OK - Provides validation results, including any errors or warnings related to the transaction.
